headline: Winthrop Holiday Tree Lighting + Bowdoin Photo Booth Bus
subject: 🎄 Winthrop Holiday Tree Lighting + Bowdoin Photo Booth Bus + what's happening around town
intro:
Hi Neighbors,
Welcome to the first edition of The Local Loop, a newsletter from Bowdoin Real Estate Partners. In each issue, we’ll highlight what’s happening locally, from events worth adding to your calendar to small businesses to discover and neighbors making a difference. We’ll round out each edition with a snapshot of the real estate market.

In this holiday edition, we’re sharing a few ways to enjoy the season. Come say hello at the Bowdoin photo booth bus during the Winthrop Tree Lighting this Friday, stop by the new Bespoke Collective pop-up, and enter our Deck the Doors contest by December 18 for a chance to win a custom painting of your home or a house cleaning.

Thanks for being here. We’re so glad you’re in the loop!
